reviews.reviewText: Kafi MCQs mutation ke mutaliq thay. Bohat zyada conceptual questions thay like 'agar ye function kharab ho jaye to kya hoga'. Mendel's law ke 2-3 questions thay. Paper 50% conceptual tha.
